source: Golden Theme variant tournament against Calm Enough For Your Chaos first principles and Layer E story-selling cards.
selector_verdict: Winner keeps the spine the creator chose while correcting the visual failure: the premise is the universal double-message of independent love, Aachu's proof is the proud 'main kar lungi', Zuv's role is active but quiet care, and the visuals stay outdoors.
calm_enough_for_chaos_alignment: Preserves the gold carousel machine: expressive Aachu anti-ideal -> concrete pride proof -> Zuv's calm active care -> tender acceptance thesis.
final_public_slide_copy_direction: She wanted to do it herself.
He helped like it was nothing.
Maybe love is care without making a scene.

candidates.name: Main Kar Lungi
candidates.universal_truth: Some independent people are not saying leave me alone; they are saying help me without making me feel small.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's full-pride 'main kar lungi' carries a hidden please stay close.
candidates.concrete_proof: An outdoor public threshold, her determined posture, and Zuv helping so quietly the moment stays hers.
candidates.zuv_role: He reads the translation and offers care without turning it into a scene.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is care without making a scene.

candidates.name: Help Without Shrinking
candidates.universal_truth: The right help does not reduce someone's independence.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu wants to do the moment herself, but wants Zuv near.
candidates.concrete_proof: He opens the path, steadies one small thing, and lets her lead.
candidates.zuv_role: His care protects her pride instead of correcting her.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is help that leaves your pride whole.

candidates.name: Don't Go Far
candidates.universal_truth: Sometimes independence is not distance; it is trust that someone will stay close.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Her sentence says I can do it, but the rhythm says stay here.
candidates.concrete_proof: A glance back on an outdoor path, Zuv close enough without crowding her.
candidates.zuv_role: He respects both messages at once.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love knows when close is enough.

candidates.name: The Quiet Hand
candidates.universal_truth: Care lands deepest when it does not announce itself.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu keeps her main-character pride while Zuv quietly solves the tiny practical edge.
candidates.concrete_proof: One easy hand at the gate or bag, then both keep walking.
candidates.zuv_role: He helps without taking over the scene.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe attention is love before it becomes a request.

candidates.name: Pride Stayed Whole
candidates.universal_truth: Being loved well can make independence feel safer, not threatened.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Her determined softness remains the center of the moment.
candidates.concrete_proof: Outdoor movement, respectful distance, and one tiny assist.
candidates.zuv_role: He makes the help feel like partnership, not rescue.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is being helped and still feeling like yourself.
